reason_not_in.cursor: Cursor's preToolUse does not enforce ask, so the gate's ask would turn into a block.

does: Experimental. Asks the user before a Sentry tool changes anything the team sees, such as a resolve or an assign.

children.does: A pattern for the full tool names of your Sentry servers. The default takes mcp__sentry__ and the hosted connector.
The read tools of the tested server version run without asking. When off, they ask too.
Every other tool asks first. So does a write run through execute_sentry_tool, an unknown tool or broken input.
